description: Renders an og:image. With OGMAKE_API_KEY configured, renders `template` via the authenticated API and returns its hosted URL plus the image bytes. With no key, renders a watermarked free image from `title` (and optional `description`/`site`) and returns image bytes only.

font.description: A Google Fonts family name, e.g. Playfair Display.

template.description: Template id (authenticated mode only, requires OGMAKE_API_KEY).

name: render_image
title: Render an OG image
